description: Profile likelihood of the perturber's light-time-corrected geocentric ecliptic-of-date longitude on 1846-09-23 (Galle). At each longitude every other free parameter (Uranus a, e, ϖ, λ₀; perturber m, [a], e ≤ 0.3, ϖ; λ₀ solved from the constraint) is re-optimised: multistart LM, neighbour continuation, then sequential left→right / right→left sweeps; dchi2 = chi2 − min over all fits for that dataset. Free-a curves add per grid point an a = 22 AU start (× 2 ϖ) and one start per M5b cell: its best-χ² posterior draw within ±2° of the grid longitude, else the nearest (extra_starts).
